title: Transition W7: author the twelve bounded diagnostic fixtures and the fixture contract
description:
Workstream W7 of the integrated ADR 0020 transition design, section 10 (the
twelve probes) and section 11 (the fixture contract):
docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md.
That design is the accepted deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed
head afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). ADR 0020 controls.

OWNER
This bead is the single owner of diagnostic fixture authoring and of the fixture
contract. No other bead owns it.

SCOPE
Author the twelve bounded diagnostic fixtures of section 10 and implement the
thirteen-field fixture contract of section 11:

  P1  rule:cover (implicit cover, player text never says "cover")
  P2  rule:opportunity-attacks (trigger plus all three exceptions)
  P3  creature:adult-black-dragon selector /data/actions/5 (Acid Breath)
  P4  spell:fireball
  P5  condition:incapacitated + rule:concentration
  P6  feature:fighter:action-surge
  P7  magic-item:cube-of-force with
      ambiguity:cube-of-force-same-face-duration-reset
  P8  magic-item:ammunition-1-2-or-3 operation hit-target
  P9  module eshyra:hollow-beneath-emberfall, encounter enc-mouth-ambush,
      creature:goblin
  P10 the jhpt-defined material-components house rule (no source ambiguity)
  P11 synthetic base + add-on override stack
  P12 table:starting-wealth-by-class as false SRD authority

Each fixture declares fields 1-13 of section 11 plus the expected deterministic
state effect, or the explicit expectation that there is none.

REQUIRED STATEMENTS (design sections 3.2, 6.1, 10, 11; ADR 0020 sections 3-4)
- Each scenario is bounded evidence for the situation it names. A scenario is
  never a completeness unit, never a partition of the corpus, and no report
  built from these fixtures may aggregate them into a coverage or completeness
  figure.
- Every identity in fields 5-13 must be verified against the current generated
  pack or adventure module at authoring time, and each fixture records the
  commit it was verified at. Where a framing and the pack disagree, the pack
  wins (feature:fighter:action-surge, not feature:action-surge; the Hollow
  Beneath Emberfall module contains no stat-block reference).
- Oracle-supplied signals must be labelled as such in the fixture, so a
  downstream stage passing on a supplied answer can never be reported as
  end-to-end success.
- Fixtures use diagnostic-fixture identity only: canonical RulesRecord.key,
  provenance.sourceRef, provenance.locator, narrowed where needed by a
  test-local selector limited to a JSON pointer, an existing ambiguity ID, an
  existing operation or compiler-emitted clause ID, or a narrowly described
  source-text predicate. These fixtures must not create a universal clause
  ontology, a universal obligation identity, or a closed relationship
  vocabulary. Source-obligation identity remains eshyra-o9bd.19.1.14's question.
- The campaign-rule fixtures (P7, P10) consume eshyra-jhpt outputs. They must
  not invent a second ruling model, schema, store, resolver, or lifecycle, and
  P10's acceptance shape is filled in by jhpt, not invented here.
- No fixture asserts a count of records ("all N creatures ..."). Assert
  identities; count-pinning is recurring failure idiom 3 of eshyra-o9bd.19.7.

NON-GOALS
- No discovery implementation, no stage harness (that is W8), no runtime
  integration, no generated-pack change, no schema change.
- No ranker, embedding model, vector database, or graph database.
- No finding is closed, retired, narrowed, or reclassified here.
- P8's target may not be re-pointed by hand: it was selected by executing
  assertMagicItemOperationReady over every magic-item operation, and any change
  requires re-running that query and restating the evidence.

DEPENDENCIES
None blocking; parallel-safe with W1-W6 (design section 14.1). Per-probe
blockers bound when a probe's evidence becomes valid, not when its fixture may
be authored: B1 eshyra-l3e5 (stat-block), B2 eshyra-seoh (P9), B3 eshyra-6vpw
(P11 "after" half), B4 eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1 (P12), B5 eshyra-uiax (P8). Each
fixture records which blocker gates its evidence.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE
Twelve committed fixtures, each recording its verification commit and gating
blocker, plus a check that every declared identity still resolves in the current
pack and module.

REQUIRED NEXT STATE
The twelve fixtures exist, are individually runnable, and are consumable by W8
without a change of shape.

MATERIAL CHANGE: no. This adds test data and a fixture contract; it introduces
no runtime surface and changes no architecture boundary.
acceptance_criteria:
Twelve fixtures exist, one per probe P1-P12, each declaring all thirteen
section-11 fields plus the expected deterministic state effect or the explicit
expectation that there is none. Every record key, selector, ambiguity ID,
operation ID, clause ID, module ID, and prose substring resolves against the
generated pack or the adventure module, and each fixture records the commit it
was verified at. Every oracle-supplied signal is explicitly labelled. Each
fixture states, in band, that it is bounded evidence for its named scenario and
not a completeness unit; no fixture or report derived from the corpus aggregates
probes into a coverage, readiness, or completeness figure. No fixture asserts a
record count. The campaign-rule fixtures reference eshyra-jhpt identities and
define no ruling schema, store, resolver, or lifecycle. P12 asserts the
false-authority evidence (source "SRD 5.1 p. 38", locator "p. 38", CC-BY block)
and never treats the record as SRD authority. Each fixture names the blocker,
if any, that gates the validity of its evidence. No production code, generated
pack data, or schema changes in this work.

TRACEABILITY: every bead in the W7-W15 set was created 2026-07-31 to execute the
design accepted as the deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed head
afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). They are parented to the ACTIVE
transition epic (eshyra-o9bd.19, or eshyra-olc5 for W13) rather than to the
closed design bead, so lifecycle semantics stay honest; eshyra-o9bd.19.8 remains
the design authority and is referenced from each description.

BOUNDARY THAT MUST NOT ERODE (design sections 8.4 and 14.3): campaign-rule
persistence and ruling lifecycle do not move out of eshyra-jhpt under any of
these items. W11 consumes; it does not own. If the jhpt interface proves
insufficient, the correct response is an amendment or a child under eshyra-jhpt,
never a discovery-local store.
